signatures.description: Implement Shamir secret sharing over GF(2^8) (AES field, reduction polynomial x^8+x^4+x^3+x+1) with n<=255 shares, threshold k, and up to e corrupted shares: decode the sharing polynomial with Berlekamp-Welch, re-evaluate it against every share, and cross-check the dealer's published SHA-256 Merkle root over H(index||share) so the program can distinguish CORRUPT_SHARES from DEALER_EQUIVOCATION. Emit the recovered secret in hex, the sorted indices proven corrupt, the classification, and the largest e for which unique decoding is still guaranteed (2e < n-k+1); when 2e >= n-k+1 report AMBIGUOUS with the two distinct degree-(k-1) polynomials that both explain the data. Must be exact for the supplied vectors including k=1, n=k (no redundancy), and all-zero secrets, and must reject non-canonical share encodings rather than silently normalizing them.
